text:
Alex: Quick sync — we need a compact playbook for geo-gating + tenant quarantine before Q3 planning. Who owns launch gates and minimal MVP scope?
Maria: +1, this keeps coming up in product priorities. Customers asking for per-tenant region pinning + graceful fallback.
Tom: Architecture heads-up: prefer a policy-first approach (policy DSL + enforcement layer) so console + API can reuse the same rules. Also need a fallback model pool for quarantined tenants.
Sarah: SRE concerns: quarantine can shift load and spike tail latency. We need circuit-breakers and autoscaling guardrails, plus a measurable SLO delta for quarantined vs normal traffic.
Lia: Customer ask: Acme wants tenant-level geo restriction + audit trail for compliance. Timeline request: they asked for Q3.
Tom: Proposal (MVP): 1) policy DSL proto to express region allowlist + quarantine triggers, 2) a boolean tenant flag (quarantined) + routing override, 3) fallback model pool and capacity reservation for quarantine, 4) telemetry hooks/events.
Maria: MVP scope should be minimal: policy storage + eval at routing layer, runbook endpoints for manual quarantine/unquarantine, console toggle, and basic audit logs. No per-tenant autoscale in v1.
Alex: Can thresholds be per-tenant? (error rate, CPU, QPS).
Tom: Yes technically, but complexity grows. Suggest enterprise-only per-tenant thresholds in v1 and global defaults for self-serve tenants.
Sarah: Ops runbook (sketch):
```
# Quarantine runbook
1. Detection: monitor > 5% error rate sustained 3m or mem pressure > 85% on model pool
2. Mark tenant.quarantined = true
3. Route traffic to fallback model pool (policy: fallback_priority)
4. Notify on-call + CS + tenant owner
5. Re-evaluate after 15m; auto-unquarantine only with health recovery and manual approval for high-risk tenants
```
Lia: I'll draft customer comms template: will include SLA impacts and expected failover behavior.
deploy-bot: routing-policy-service v1.2 deployed to staging :rocket: (canary 0.5% enabled)
Tom: Open design questions: quarantine metric choice (error vs resource pressure), fallback semantics (use cheaper quantized model vs degraded quality), and capacity budgeting. Need perf numbers for our model pools.
Maria: Launch gates suggestion: telemetry ingestion + dashboards, canary at 1% traffic, automated rollback within 15 minutes on error spikes, and a postmortem + customer notification template.
Alex: Action items: Tom - write spec doc by Friday (include policy DSL examples); Sarah - SRE playbook + SLO impact analysis; Maria - finalize MVP list and launch gates; Lia - collect customer constraint matrix (Acme + two other enterprise trials). I'll update roadmap and link here.
Tom: ack
Sarah: ack :white_check_mark:
Lia: ack, will ping Acme and share responses before EOD Thu
Alex: Thanks team — collating notes into roadmap doc: https://redwood.internal/roadmap/routing-quarantine (will attach spec draft once Tom posts).
